messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "should be taken with food, with the evening meal"
set: ["should be taken with food, with the evening meal", "some forms are taken only once daily with the evening meal", "1800 mg orally once daily with the evening meal", "1800 mg orally with the evening meal on day 15", "300 mg orally with the evening meal on day 1", "600 mg orally with the evening meal on day 2", "titrated to 1800 mg orally once daily with the evening meal", "500 mg orally once a day with evening meal", "1200 mg orally with the evening meal on days 7 through 10", "oral granules should be taken 30 minutes before a meal", "900 mg orally with the evening meal on days 3 through 6", "1500 mg orally with the evening meal on days 11 through 14", "next dose should be taken the following day", "may be taken with or without food", "can be taken with or without food", "take with a meal or immediately after a meal"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
